name: Age Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Age Simulator!

Instead of leaving a dislike, let me know what we can do better in the group! 👍

You age 1 year every 60 seconds!

Game just released so expect bugs and frequent updates!
More Areas coming soon!

Controls:
Q / X - Punch
E / Y - Kick
R / LB - Rest
T / RB - Sit
Shift / B - Run / Walk

Train or fight others to gain exp and get stronger!

Age up as time goes by!
Protect your family and fight to be the strongest survivor!

Remember to leave a like and favorite if you enjoy!

Latest Updates:
- Added Pyramid Zone and Tree House
- Added Age Save
- Fixed Bugs

Have suggestions? Post them in my group:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/8202816
